tldr: Mars through the 8th house brings focus to shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement.
body: Mars transiting the 8th house energizes shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports shared money and deep trust: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or control, avoidance, or crisis attachment.
advice: Aim the fire in the 8th house deliberately. Work with shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
